Sent Estimates is work you have quoted.
Each one shows the customer, the project, the amount, and where it stands.
An estimate is an offer, not money — it does not touch your totals until it is accepted, which is exactly what you want in a pipeline number.
When a builder says yes, convert it into an invoice rather than retyping it; the lines come across with it.
When you lose one, mark it lost, so what is left in the list is real work you might still get.
